gaps.message: Places come from the City's facility registers (and OpenStreetMap for shopping centres). They can be incomplete or out of date, and include only the kinds of place listed.
88 places just outside the ward boundaries (mostly beaches seaward of the ward line) are counted in the nearest ward.
